entries.question: What is Career Uttsav?
entries.answer: Career Uttsav is a two-day career and education fair where you can explore careers, meet top universities, connect with mentors and get real answers about your future, all under one roof! Whether you're sure about your plans or still figuring things out, there's something here for you.

entries.question: Where is Career Uttsav happening?
entries.answer: Career Uttsav 2026 is at Gate No. 9, Princess Golf, Palace Grounds, Bengaluru.

entries.question: Is entry free?
entries.answer: Yes, Career Uttsav is completely free to attend! You can register right here on WhatsApp.

entries.question: Can college students attend?
entries.answer: You're welcome to come and explore at Career Uttsav! Meet universities, mentors and industry experts and build your network while you're at it.

entries.question: Can I attend on both days?
entries.answer: Career Uttsav is on both 19 and 20 December 2026, and you're welcome to come on both days! Pre-register to block your place.

entries.question: How do I contact the team?
entries.answer: Happy to help! You can reach our Career Uttsav support team, Chirag Jain on 6364224321.

entries.question: How do I register?
entries.answer: Sure! We can complete your Career Uttsav registration right here in this chat. Just say "register" to get started.

entries.question: Can I register on this WhatsApp number?
entries.answer: Yes! You're already in the right place. This is also our registration WhatsApp number, so you can register and get your pass here without switching anywhere else.

entries.question: Is my registration confirmed?
entries.answer: Let me check that for you. I'll securely verify your details and look up your live registration status.

entries.question: I have registered already.
entries.answer: Great! Would you like me to pull up your event pass or check your registration details?

entries.question: Can you send my event pass?
entries.answer: Absolutely! Let me verify your registration and I'll send the pass linked to your account right here.

entries.question: I did not receive my pass.
entries.answer: No worries, let's check it together. I'll look up your registration and resend the pass if it's ready.

entries.question: Can you register my child?
entries.answer: Of course! I can help you register your child right here. We'll collect the required student details and any parent or guardian consent needed.

entries.question: Can I register multiple students?
entries.answer: We can help with that! For registering a group, please reach out to our team, Chirag Jain on 6364224321, and he'll guide you at the earliest.

entries.question: Do parents need separate passes?
entries.answer: Yes, parents will need a pass to enter the event too, and it's free! They can register right here on this WhatsApp number or through the form on our website. It hardly takes 2 minutes.

entries.question: Can I register at the venue?
entries.answer: The best way is to pre-register and block your place for the event! It helps you skip the long queues on event day, and it hardly takes 2 minutes. You can even do it right here on WhatsApp, while you're stuck in Bengaluru traffic! Just say "register" and we'll get you started.

entries.question: Can I change my name or school?
entries.answer: Registration changes and cancellations are handled by our support team. Please contact Chirag Jain on 6364224321 for help with this.

entries.question: I entered the wrong phone number.
entries.answer: Changes like this are handled by our customer support team. Please reach out to Chirag Jain on 6364224321. He'll guide you and get everything sorted at the earliest.

entries.question: I forgot my registration ID.
entries.answer: That's okay! We can look up your registration securely using your verified details.

entries.question: Is registration compulsory?
entries.answer: Yes, registration is needed to attend, and it's completely free! It hardly takes 2 minutes right here on WhatsApp. Just say "register" to get started.

entries.question: What is the last date to register?
entries.answer: Registration is open at all times, so you can register whenever you like! Registering early is a good idea though: it blocks your place and helps you skip the queues on event day. It takes hardly 2 minutes right here on WhatsApp.

entries.question: Can I cancel my registration?
entries.answer: For cancellations, please reach out to our customer support team, Chirag Jain on 6364224321. He'll guide you through it at the earliest.

entries.question: Is my registration free?
entries.answer: Yes, registration is completely free!

entries.question: Can I forward my pass to someone?
entries.answer: Event passes can't be passed on to someone else. Each pass is for the person who registered. Please ask your friend or family member to register themselves, right here on this WhatsApp number or through the form on our website. It hardly takes 2 minutes!

entries.question: I have a registration problem.
entries.answer: I'm here to help! For any registration problem, please reach out to our customer support team, Chirag Jain on 6364224321, and he'll get it sorted at the earliest.

entries.question: Is bus transport available?
entries.answer: Yes, we can help you with a bus facility from our end! It's best to connect with our team so they can guide you through the details better. Please reach out to Chirag Jain on 6364224321.

entries.question: Can you arrange a bus from my school?
entries.answer: Yes, we can help you with a bus facility from our end! It's best to connect with our team so they can guide you through the details better. Please reach out to Chirag Jain on 6364224321.

entries.question: Where is the bus pickup point?
entries.answer: Our team will be happy to guide you on the pickup details. Please reach out to Chirag Jain on 6364224321 for clarity.

entries.answer: Yes, parking is free at the venue!

entries.answer: Yes! A quick bite will be given at the venue, and there are pay-and-eat counters too.

entries.answer: Yes! Drinking water is available at the event to keep you hydrated and energetic all day.

entries.answer: Yes, washrooms are available at the venue.

entries.answer: Yes, the venue is wheelchair accessible. ♿

entries.answer: Yes, you can! In fact, we recommend bringing a bag. You'll be collecting lots of brochures and collaterals to take back home.

entries.question: Is there a help desk?
entries.answer: Yes, there's a help desk at the event. You can reach out to them whenever you need any assistance.

entries.answer: Don't worry! Please reach out to the nearest help desk at the event and they'll help you out.

entries.answer: Yes, a first-aid kit is available at the event. 啕

entries.question: What if it rains?
entries.answer: No worries! The event is in a closed venue, so you can come along without worrying about the weather. ️

entries.question: What seminars are happening?
entries.answer: We've got 14 exciting seminars and panel discussions across 19 and 20 December! Here's the full seminar poster so you can explore all the topics.

entries.question: Can you send the seminar schedule?
entries.answer: Absolutely! Here's the full list of seminars for both days.

entries.question: What is happening on Saturday?
entries.answer: Saturday, 19 December has sessions on finding your passion, engineering, design, management, liberal arts, commerce and finance, and studying abroad. Here's the poster with the complete list!

entries.question: What is happening on Sunday?
entries.answer: Sunday, 20 December covers medicine, law, entrepreneurship, funding higher education, future engineering careers, unusual career paths and board exam preparation. Here's the poster!

entries.question: What time does each seminar start?
entries.answer: Here's the seminar poster with all the topics, day by day! Follow us on Instagram or check our website for the latest updates.

entries.question: Who are the speakers?
entries.answer: We have speakers and mentors from the top of the industry, well-known universities and many fields! To keep a live track of the speakers, follow us on Instagram or check our website.

entries.question: Can I attend multiple seminars?
entries.answer: Yes, definitely! Career Uttsav is organised to help students find career clarity, so you can attend as many seminars as you like.

entries.question: Do I need to book a seminar separately?
entries.answer: Seats for the seminars are on a first-come, first-served basis. For any details on seminar entry, please reach out to Chirag Jain on 6364224321.

entries.question: Are seminar seats limited?
entries.answer: Seminar seats are on a first-come, first-served basis, so we'd suggest reaching early to get your spot!

entries.question: Can parents attend seminars?
entries.answer: Yes, definitely! The seminars are for parents too, so you can make an informed decision for your child's future.

entries.question: Can you recommend a seminar for me?
entries.answer: We have 14 seminars across both days, covering engineering, business, design, law, medicine and more! Here's the poster so you can pick the ones that excite you.

entries.question: Will seminars be recorded?
entries.answer: Our seminars won't be recorded. We believe in in-person interaction and understanding. Being there lets you listen, ask your questions and connect with the speakers directly.

entries.question: Which universities are participating?
entries.answer: Career Uttsav brings top universities together under one roof! Keep following our social media pages and website for the latest updates, and come meet them in person to get all your questions answered.

entries.question: Is RV University participating?
entries.answer: Career Uttsav brings top universities together under one roof! Keep following our social media pages and website for the latest updates, and come meet them in person to get all your questions answered.

entries.question: Is Manipal participating?
entries.answer: Career Uttsav brings top universities together under one roof! Keep following our social media pages and website for the latest updates, and come meet them in person to get all your questions answered.

entries.question: Are there BBA colleges?
entries.answer: Yes, you can explore management options at Career Uttsav! Meet top universities under one roof and get your questions answered in person. Keep following our social media pages and website for updates.

entries.question: Are engineering colleges coming?
entries.answer: You can explore engineering options at Career Uttsav! Meet top universities under one roof and get your questions answered in person. Keep following our social media pages and website for updates.

entries.question: Will there be medical colleges?
entries.answer: There's a seminar on Careers in Medicine & Health Sciences on 20 December! 喙 Come explore at Career Uttsav, meet top universities under one roof and get your questions answered. Keep following our social media pages and website for updates.

entries.question: Are there study abroad options?
entries.answer: There's a seminar called 'Your Journey to Study Abroad' on 19 December! Come explore your options at Career Uttsav, meet top universities and mentors, and get your questions answered.

entries.question: Can I apply for admission at the event?
entries.answer: You can speak with the participating universities about their admission process! Whether you can apply on the spot depends on the institution, so meet them at the event and ask directly.

entries.question: Are scholarships available?
entries.answer: You can definitely ask the participating universities about scholarships! Details vary by institution, so meet them in person at Career Uttsav and get all your answers.

entries.question: Can I compare college fees?
entries.answer: Come explore at Career Uttsav! You can meet top universities under one roof and get all the details you need about their courses directly from them, so you can compare and decide better.

entries.question: Can I meet admission counsellors?
entries.answer: Yes, the event is designed to help you interact with universities and ask questions about courses and admissions. Come along and meet them all under one roof!

entries.question: Will I get a university list?
entries.answer: Yes! During the event, a souvenir will be provided with all the university details, including phone numbers, email IDs and more, so you can connect with the right person and take your journey ahead.

entries.question: Which university is best?
entries.answer: The right fit is different for every student, so we don't rank universities. Come explore at Career Uttsav, meet top universities under one roof and clarify all your doubts in person. Keep following our social media pages and website for updates.

entries.question: Is the psychometric test free?
entries.answer: Yes! A free psychometric test is part of Career Uttsav, and it helps you understand your strengths and interests.

entries.question: How do I take the psychometric test?
entries.answer: It's easy! You can take the free psychometric test through Career Uttsav. For the exact steps, please reach out to our support team, Chirag Jain on 6364224321.

entries.question: Will I get a report?
entries.answer: For all the details about the psychometric test and your report, please reach out to our support team, Chirag Jain on 6364224321.

entries.question: I am confused about my career.
entries.answer: That's completely okay! You don't need to have everything figured out today. Coming to Career Uttsav is a great way to explore, meet universities, learn from mentors and network with leaders in the field. All of this will help you build your profile and gain clarity about your path.

entries.question: What should I choose after Class 10?
entries.answer: Let's explore that together at Career Uttsav! Meet top universities, mentors and industry experts, and understand what each stream can lead to. It's a great way to gain clarity before choosing.

entries.question: Should I choose science or commerce?
entries.answer: Both can lead to great opportunities, and the right one depends on you! Come explore this at Career Uttsav: meet top universities, leaders, mentors and industry experts to gain better clarity. You can also start with a free psychometric test to understand your strengths.

entries.question: What is better, BBA or BCom?
entries.answer: That's a big decision, and we'd love to help you with it! Let's explore it together at Career Uttsav. You can start by understanding your strengths with a free psychometric test, meet top mentors and industry leaders, and get answers to all your questions in one place.

entries.question: Can I pursue law after commerce?
entries.answer: Yes! Commerce students can explore law pathways too, and the route depends on the programme and its eligibility rules. There's a seminar on Building a Successful Career in Law on 20 December. Come explore it at Career Uttsav!

entries.question: What can I do without mathematics?
entries.answer: There are plenty of possibilities! Come explore them at Career Uttsav: meet top universities, mentors and industry experts to gain better clarity on the options that suit you.

entries.question: What are careers in AI?
entries.answer: AI opens up paths in machine learning, data science, AI product development and more! 烙 We have engineering seminars on both days. Come explore it at Career Uttsav and meet industry experts.

entries.question: Can gaming become a career?
entries.answer: It can! There are roles in game design, development, art, testing, esports operations and content creation. Come explore this at Career Uttsav and meet mentors and industry experts to gain clarity.

entries.question: How do I study abroad?
entries.answer: Exciting goal! We have a seminar called 'Your Journey to Study Abroad' on 19 December, and here's the poster. Come explore your options at Career Uttsav!

entries.question: How do education loans work?
entries.answer: Education loans can help cover eligible study expenses, though terms vary by lender. We have a session on How to Fund Your Higher Education on 20 December, and here's the poster!

entries.question: How can I score better in board exams?
entries.answer: A realistic study plan, past-paper practice and regular revision can help! There's also a session called 'How to Score Better in Board Exams?' on 20 December, and here's the poster.

entries.question: What are creative career options?
entries.answer: You could explore design, architecture, animation, UX, film, media and more! There's a session on Design, Architecture & Creative Careers on 19 December, and here's the poster. Come explore it at Career Uttsav!

entries.question: I got low marks. What can I do?
entries.answer: Marks matter for some courses, but they don't define all your options. Come explore at Career Uttsav: meet top universities, mentors and industry experts to gain clarity on the paths open to you.

entries.question: Can you recommend a college?
entries.answer: Come explore at Career Uttsav! Meet top universities under one roof, talk to mentors and industry experts, and find the college that fits you best.
